geometry_headroom_followup_2026_10_19.status: post-interim plan, recorded before these runs; exploratory development evidence
geometry_headroom_followup_2026_10_19.validation: seq3 two-target adapter run before all 13 promptable dev sequences; repeat seq3 validation is not pooled
geometry_headroom_followup_2026_10_19.targets: Same first/last eligible rule as prior replays; no outcome selection

geometry.bank: recent spatial memory; conditioning and pointers unchanged
geometry.supports: Four existing categories against their respective complements; mixed coverage against pure coverage additionally matches inside/outside
geometry.strata: Same memory frame and exact squared Euclidean token-centre distance to the existing inner contour; mixed/pure additionally matches side. Empty masks have no defined distance and contribute no matched stratum.
geometry.budget: At most 64 keys per arm per target-bank comparison. Explicit common-support subsampling: capacity=min(target count, disjoint control count) in each stratum; sample quotas then exact-match controls without replacement. No support means skipped, not relaxed matching.
geometry.estimand: Regional removal harm minus its own disjoint exact-distance control, on matched common support only; not full-region importance or an estimate over unsupported strata

headroom.regions: Stored native predicted masks before the target; no GT region supports in bias construction
headroom.bank: recent only; conditioning and pointers unchanged
headroom.candidates: Eight candidates: +1 and -1 logit for each of four categories, centered per memory frame. Shared unmodified baseline available to both searches.
headroom.null: Eight randomized candidates per seed, obtained by within-frame permutation of each actual regional bias vector; identical per-frame norm and value histogram; seeds 0,1,2
headroom.selection: Max target GT Dice including baseline; boundary F evaluated for that same Dice-selected candidate. No writeback. Oracle diagnostic only; not a deployable score or a fair test-set method comparison.
headroom.statistics: Regional oracle gain minus mean best-of-8 random gain, paired within target then averaged within sequence. Two conditions form one Holm family per endpoint. Geometry uses ten region-by-condition tests per endpoint. Bootstrap whole sequences 10000 times; no independent-frame or independent-seed inference.

geometry_headroom_followup_2026_10_19.method_gate: Do not auto-launch training. Report natural-condition headroom gain and excess versus equal-search null. Recommend a CUDA training preflight only if at least ten sequences support the headroom comparison, mean regional-oracle Dice gain >=0.01 and its excess-gain 95% CI lower bound >0; also require evidence of regional effects beyond geometry. Otherwise retain diagnostic framing, distinguishing insufficient power/support from a negative finding.
geometry_headroom_followup_2026_10_19.runtime: Sequential MPS sequence shards, fresh output names, mandatory online W&B and Drive outputs. Per-shard wall bound 45 minutes. Stop queue on failed exactness check. Existing midnight cutoff applied to the previous queue, not this newly authorized follow-up.

local_attention_followup_2026_10_18.timing: Written after earlier local diagnostic results, before new attention measurements
local_attention_followup_2026_10_18.question: How do foreground-interior, boundary, near-background and far-background tokens differ in native attention allocation and segmentation removal effects?
local_attention_followup_2026_10_18.adapter_validation: seq3, same two index-selected targets, all four existing conditions. Chunked post-RoPE attention reconstruction must have max absolute error <= 1e-4, total mass within 1e-4 of one, and bit-identical decoder logits compared with the native unobserved replay. Do not pool the repeat seq3 intervention rows with the previous seq3 shard.
local_attention_followup_2026_10_18.selection: All remaining promptable development sequences not in the earlier eight-sequence counterfactual sample; not selected for observed benefit
local_attention_followup_2026_10_18.measurement: Reuse native SAM2 SDPA output. Reconstruct weights in 32-query chunks after native projection and RoPE, all layers, all native queries averaged over heads. Report spatial categories per stored frame and pointers separately; normalize mass by token count before interpreting enrichment. Oracle category supports are diagnostic only, not deployable inputs.
local_attention_followup_2026_10_18.controls: Unchanged existing four conditions, two index-selected targets, two banks, equal-boundary-budget regional removals and five random-control seeds. No relaxed matching or tuning from these results.
local_attention_followup_2026_10_18.aggregation: Targets first, then equal sequence weights. Each sequence is a separate shard; incomplete shards excluded. Attention mass is descriptive saliency, not causal importance. Pair against removal harms, and retain feasibility limitations.
local_attention_followup_2026_10_18.scope: Local regional diagnostics; not the full study or evidence of a trained-method gain

scope: Foreground/background/boundary memory-token study; excludes superseded latent-utility claims
running_kaggle: Leave the pinned frame-matched E2 job unchanged
primary_question: Do explicit regions add information beyond proximity, and does their effect depend on memory corruption?

model.initialization: first labeled visible-frame GT mask once; no detector corrections
model.memory: native seven-frame memory settings, object pointers on

geometry.contour: inner contour of occupied grid, 3x3 erosion, outside-image background
geometry.distance: Euclidean token-centre distance to inner contour; negative inside; undefined for empty mask
geometry.controls: disjoint, no replacement; preserve frame and absolute-distance-bin counts; no relaxed matching
geometry.mixed_control: Mixed-versus-pure intervention also matches inside/outside within frame and absolute-distance bin. Report a separate side-matched feasibility audit; do not replace the earlier distance-only audit.
geometry.infeasible: record and skip, never silently shrink full boundary budget

local_plan.A1_feasibility: All 21 promptable PolypGen sequences; oracle GT geometry only, no prediction or performance claim; report full-budget and support counts
local_plan.MPS_validation: seq2 prefix, 12 frames from prompt, independent native and zero-controller rollouts; require bit-identical logits before diagnosis
local_plan.Bplus_diagnosis: seq13 and seq14, natural propagation and all spatial keys suppressed; same single mask prompt; pointers retained
local_plan.sampled_counterfactual: After fresh validation, eight dev sequences seq2-6,8-10; two index-selected targets (first eligible and last); independent c0,c1,c2,natural spatial-bank reconstructions at each target; preserve natural pointers and history outside selected bank. Existing corruption operators and equal-budget interventions, five random seeds, conditioning/recent separate. Includes fixed oracle category supports, recorded overlap, signed query-region Dice harm. This is a sampled matched-bank perturbation experiment, not accumulated corrupted rollouts or full A3.
local_plan.persistent_followup: After the sampled counterfactuals, seq13/14 only if the completed B+ native baseline has a failure episode. Reuse persistent_region_rollout: recent-bank boundary, foreground, near_background, far_background and five uniform-random seeds, all at the current boundary token budget; predicted-mask categories recomputed after each native memory write; conditioning and pointers unchanged. Record infeasible reads with no intervention. First run a 12-frame prefix to validate the adapter, then full intervals if it passes. Descriptive two-sequence A4 follow-up only; no unique error attribution or population significance.
local_plan.complete_local_baseline: As compute allows before midnight, run native B+ on all 21 promptable sequences in original chronological filename order, independently of failures and outcomes. One first-visible mask prompt; no corrections; pointers on. Equal-weight mean of completed full-sequence post-prompt Dice; only call it the full 21-sequence baseline if all finish. This is not the detector-assisted all-23 YOLO benchmark.
local_plan.diagnosis_interpretation: Spatial suppression is not complete memory-off and may remove target identity. Differences do not alone prove errors were carried by a particular region.
local_plan.deadline_policy: Stop cleanly at a frame boundary; retain partial results with completed=false; never claim whole-sequence coverage from a prefix

analysis.unit: sequence; frames and training seeds are not independent units
analysis.inference: n=2 diagnosis is descriptive only; no population significance claim
analysis.multiple_comparisons: Holm within prespecified endpoint families; whole-sequence bootstrap
analysis.success_safety: Future method claims require non-inferiority with a prospectively fixed margin, not failure to reject loss
